---
name: Bug report
about: A function returns the wrong result or breaks a rule
title: ''
labels: ''
assignees: ''
---

**Function and version**
`@moonloch/dcc-core-lib` version (or vendored commit) and the function involved, e.g. `castSpell`, `rollCritical`.

**Inputs**
The smallest input that reproduces it (synthetic data is fine; do not paste official rulebook text or table values).

**Expected result**
What should happen, with the rule it comes from as a table/page reference only.

**Actual result**
What happens instead.

**Context**
Consumer app (DCC FoundryVTT system, your own tool, ...) and anything else relevant.
